notes.title: Bloody Zombies | Update 1 Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28734688/6a7ca8b04831d86cd7a1baf147ef3490b2d07594.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Friday![/h1]
Thank you all so much for your feedback on [i][b]Bloody Zombies![/b][/i] We've just released our first update which includes an Easy mode and minor fixes.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Easy mode added:[/b]
[list]
[*]6 lives instead of 3
[*]Boss health reduced
[*]All small medi packs switched for medium medi packs
[*]Reviver zombie removed and replaced with ranged enemy
[/list]
- Keyboard prompts now appear when playing with keyboard
- Hit range increased in Z depth
- Reviver Zombie now has a tip of how to kill it – explosive Kill Required appear above his head

[h1]Got any questions?[/h1]
You can get in touch with us on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/449640/discussions/]forum![/url]

[h1]Need support?[/h1]
Please contact support@ndreams.com if you're having trouble. Replies will be in English. Alternatively, leave a post in our dedicated support [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/449640/discussions/1/]sub forum[/url] and one of the team will respond.
